# The runtime (M2: strict stops only). Title tables are generated into the build tree from the
# survey (scripts/gen_runtime_tables.py): no title address in runtime source. Warnings are errors
# and none is disabled.
# (The tables are generated by the top-level CMakeLists.txt, target fm4_generated.)
file(GLOB FM4_KERNEL_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/kernel/*.cpp)
file(GLOB FM4_VIDEO_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/video/*.cpp)
# game/: the runtime's title code (title hooks' handlers; names only, FM4's numbers in config/title_hooks.toml).
file(GLOB FM4_GAME_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/game/*.cpp)
# shader/shader_glsl.cpp: the Xenos microcode -> GLSL translator (reviewed unit), used by video/shader_cache.cpp.
add_executable(fm4recomp main.cpp stops.cpp guest_memory.cpp audio_sdl.cpp disc_setup_sdl.cpp controls_panel_sdl.cpp xma_ffmpeg.cpp ldi_mspack.cpp ${FM4_KERNEL_SOURCES} ${FM4_VIDEO_SOURCES} ${FM4_GAME_SOURCES} shader/shader_glsl.cpp ${FM4_GENERATED}/fm4_imports.cpp ${FM4_GENERATED}/fm4_hooks.cpp ${FM4_GENERATED}/fm4_image.h)
target_include_directories(fm4recomp PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/kernel ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/recomp ${FM4_GENERATED})
# TinySHA1 (XenonRecomp's pinned thirdparty, ISC-style licence in its header): the STFS hash tree (kernel/stfs.cpp; FM4 Recomp, Disc 2).
target_include_directories(fm4recomp PRIVATE ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/XenonRecomp/thirdparty/TinySHA1)
# SDL3 for the audible audio sink only (audio_sdl.cpp); the runtime tests build kernel/ without it.
find_package(SDL3 REQUIRED CONFIG)
target_link_libraries(fm4recomp PRIVATE fm4_ppc SDL3::SDL3 objc "-framework AppKit")  # objc + AppKit: controls_panel_sdl.cpp's focus hand-over
target_link_libraries(fm4recomp PRIVATE "-framework CoreText" "-framework CoreGraphics")  # video/keycap_text_mac.cpp (FM4_KEYCAP_ICONS)
# FFmpeg for XMA (xma_ffmpeg.cpp only): the pinned, LGPL, xmaframes-only build of scripts/build_ffmpeg_xma.sh
# (it checks the licence; the runtime checks the linked library again at start-up).
# FM4_LGPL_SHARED (the release build, as in ReCarbon): the LGPL parts are libraries of their own, never inside a program, so
# a user can replace them (LGPL-2.1 section 6; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): FFmpeg's libavcodec.61.dylib and libavutil.59.dylib
# from FM4_FFMPEG_XMA (a `shared` build), and libmspack's LZX decoder as libfm4_lzx.dylib. Off: the development build links
# the static tools/ffmpeg-xma of scripts/setup_tools.sh and compiles the decoder in.
option(FM4_LGPL_SHARED "FFmpeg and the LZX decoder as separate libraries (the release build)" OFF)
set(FM4_FFMPEG_XMA ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/ffmpeg-xma CACHE PATH "the FFmpeg build of scripts/build_ffmpeg_xma.sh")
if(FM4_LGPL_SHARED)
  set(FM4_FFMPEG_LIBS ${FM4_FFMPEG_XMA}/lib/libavcodec.61.dylib ${FM4_FFMPEG_XMA}/lib/libavutil.59.dylib)
  set(FM4_LZX_KIND SHARED)
else()
  set(FM4_FFMPEG_LIBS ${FM4_FFMPEG_XMA}/lib/libavcodec.a ${FM4_FFMPEG_XMA}/lib/libavutil.a)
  set(FM4_LZX_KIND STATIC)
endif()
foreach(lib IN LISTS FM4_FFMPEG_LIBS)
  if(NOT EXISTS ${lib})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "${lib} is missing: run scripts/setup_tools.sh (or, for FM4_LGPL_SHARED, scripts/build_ffmpeg_xma.sh ... shared)")
  endif()
endforeach()
target_include_directories(fm4recomp PRIVATE ${FM4_FFMPEG_XMA}/include)
target_link_libraries(fm4recomp PRIVATE ${FM4_FFMPEG_LIBS})
# libmspack's LZX decoder (LGPL-2.1) from the pinned XenonRecomp tree, for the kernel's LDI decompression (ldi_mspack.cpp).
enable_language(C)
set(FM4_MSPACK ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/XenonRecomp/thirdparty/libmspack/libmspack/mspack)
add_library(fm4_lzxd ${FM4_LZX_KIND} ${FM4_MSPACK}/lzxd.c)
target_include_directories(fm4_lzxd PUBLIC ${FM4_MSPACK})
target_compile_options(fm4_lzxd PRIVATE -O2)
target_link_libraries(fm4recomp PRIVATE fm4_lzxd)
if(FM4_LGPL_SHARED)
  set_target_properties(fm4_lzxd PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME fm4_lzx INSTALL_NAME_DIR @rpath BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_NAME_DIR ON)
  target_link_options(fm4_lzxd PRIVATE -Wl,-headerpad_max_install_names)
  # The kit's xexsurvey: the source and libraries of scripts/setup_tools.sh's, with the LZX decoder taken from the library
  # (named before libXenonUtils.a, whose own copy of the decoder is then never linked; scripts/release/bundle_kit.sh checks).
  set(FM4_XR ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/XenonRecomp)
  add_executable(xexsurvey ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/survey/xexsurvey.cpp)
  target_compile_options(xexsurvey PRIVATE -O2 -include cstdlib)
  target_include_directories(xexsurvey PRIVATE ${FM4_XR}/XenonUtils ${FM4_XR}/thirdparty ${FM4_XR}/thirdparty/disasm
    ${FM4_XR}/thirdparty/fmt/include ${FM4_XR}/thirdparty/xxHash ${FM4_XR}/thirdparty/TinySHA1 ${FM4_XR}/thirdparty/tiny-AES-c)
  target_link_libraries(xexsurvey PRIVATE fm4_lzxd ${FM4_XR}/build/XenonUtils/libXenonUtils.a ${FM4_XR}/build/thirdparty/fmt/libfmt.a
    ${FM4_XR}/build/thirdparty/disasm/libdisasm.a ${FM4_XR}/build/thirdparty/xxHash/cmake_unofficial/libxxhash.a)
endif()
# Vulkan (the M4 renderer, video/*.cpp): Homebrew vulkan-loader and headers 1.4.363.
# The driver is never linked: the loader finds MoltenVK through the ICD manifest scripts/gpu_run.sh pins (VK_DRIVER_FILES).
find_package(Vulkan 1.4.363 EXACT REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(fm4recomp PRIVATE Vulkan::Vulkan)
# The validation layer's negative control, run by scripts/gpu_run.sh before every GPU run.
add_executable(fm4_validation_control ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/video/validation_control.cpp)
target_link_libraries(fm4_validation_control PRIVATE Vulkan::Vulkan)
target_compile_options(fm4_validation_control PRIVATE -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
set_target_properties(fm4_validation_control PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests)
add_dependencies(fm4recomp fm4_validation_control)
# glslang 16.6.0 (Homebrew), pinned as Vulkan is: the shader cache (video/shader_cache.cpp) compiles GLSL to SPIR-V at run
# time with the census's options. Configure fails when it is missing or another version: no fallback to a tool spawn.
find_package(glslang 16.6.0 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
foreach(target IN ITEMS glslang::glslang glslang::SPIRV glslang::glslang-default-resource-limits)
  if(NOT TARGET ${target})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "glslang ${glslang_VERSION}: imported target ${target} is missing (brew install glslang)")
  endif()
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(fm4recomp PRIVATE glslang::glslang glslang::SPIRV glslang::glslang-default-resource-limits)
foreach(module IN LISTS FM4_MODULES)
  target_link_libraries(fm4recomp PRIVATE ${module}_ppc)
endforeach()
add_dependencies(fm4recomp fm4_generated check_module_symbols)
target_compile_options(fm4recomp PRIVATE -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
